message: No detected untrusted source handling: Data is read from local files via os.path.join and open(), with no remote fetching, so no checksum or authentication controls are needed or present.
No detected label flipping detection: The code performs no checks on label distributions, validation against an expected label set, or use of any label-noise detection tool before training.

No detected data poisoning defenses: While Infinity/NaN values are replaced with -1 in the CICIDS path, there is no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checking, or filtering of suspicious training samples that would constitute a poisoning defense.

No detected model integrity verification: No pretrained weights or serialized models are loaded in this code; models are built and trained from scratch with no hash checks, signature verification, or pinned revisions present.

No detected label distribution validation: The code loads training data and calls .fit() directly without any class balance checks, expected-label-set validation, or anomalous sample detection before training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.

No detected differential privacy: The code uses standard Keras/scikit-learn training with a plain Adam optimizer and no differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) is imported or used.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, CleverHans) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the evaluation code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While a separate test set is used via train_test_split, there is no hashing/signing of evaluation data, no isolation enforcement beyond variable scope, and no independent verification mechanism to prevent metric manipulation.

No detected output bounds checks: Model predictions are used directly (e.g., model.predict_classes, model.predict) with no NaN guards, probability sanity bounds, or threshold checks on the returned values.
No detected prompt injection defenses: The models are classic ML/DNN classifiers for network intrusion detection, not LLMs, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
